founder.name: Syed Ahmed Jamal
founder.bio: Syed Ahmed Jamal, a final-year Electronics Engineering student at NED University of Engineering & Technology, leads Nexvia with a vision centered on precision, clarity, and practical hardware design. His work focuses on delivering clean, reliable PCB solutions backed by real engineering understanding. By combining modern design presentation with hands-on technical experience, he ensures that every project maintains both visual quality and functional integrity.

mission: To support students and professionals with cost-effective, industry-ready PCB solutions backed by practical engineering guidance. We focus on simplifying the design-to-production process while ensuring every project meets strong standards of performance, reliability, and real-world usability.
